item.title: Search or filter events
item.description: 1. Event search link Under “Events” of the APP, you can search for events by event serial number 2. Event filtering link There are two states of events, occurring and recovered, which can be filtered by the title

item.title: Event Details
item.description: Click the event at the bottom of the APP to enter the event interface Click the event in the event list to enter the event details interface View the event details
